request.query: Residence permit for an employed person

sources.title: suomi.fi
highlights: You will probably need a residence permit to work in Finland if you are not a citizen of an EU Member State, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway or Switzerland

sources.title: migri.fi
highlights: To be allowed to move to Finland for longer than 90 days, you need a residence permit
In contrast, if you apply for a residence permit on some other grounds while in Finland, the decision will usually be negative

sources.title: migri.fi
highlights: You can fill in the application online in Enter Finland

A valid passport issued by your country of nationality. For more information, see the page Passports and other travel documents. Show the passport when you visit a service point to prove your identity
The passport photo must be no more than 6 months old
Colour copies of the passport page containing personal data and of all passport pages that contain notes
Document showing that you are legally staying in the country where you submit the application
After you have submitted your application in Enter Finland, your employer must add your terms of employment and other required documents to your application using Enter Finland for Employers

sources.title: migri.fi
highlights: When you apply for a first residence permit, you must always visit a Finnish embassy or consulate abroad to prove your identity in person

sources.title: exa.ai
highlights: I normally wait 3-4 months to get me residence permit extended
